name: Corner of Sovereign St. & Noble St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. Sovereign street leads off steadily to the
desc3: north, ending in the crossroads of the Town Square. To the west, the
desc4: street becomes Noble street, following the southern city wall. It is
desc5: quiet and lonely here, and the slight wind gives you a chill. There is
desc6: a spiked iron fence to the east, but it is so densely covered in
desc7: greenery that you cannot see through it.
